notice: How each v0.2.0 AI judgment finding was handled in v0.3.0. Written by the agent that made the corrections. These are statements of what changed, not review verdicts: every correction needs independent review.

dispositions.change: Added definition pl-w1: original, unscaffolded argumentative writing on a new question at the end of the lesson, scored with the candidate rubric. Selected-response items remain as diagnostic support. The in-lesson writing is still formative.
g7-essay-exit-1, -4 and -5 are marked diagnostic-only (asked, not counted as mastery evidence). Definitions pl-r1 and pl-r2 ask the learner to judge, repair and answer an argument.
g7-essay-exit-1 option 3 is now unmapped. mc-thesis-placement was not added; it waits for classroom evidence.
Added mc-explain-restates-evidence, taught it in the peel scene, remapped g7-essay-exit-5 option 3 to it, and named it in the rubric's explain-link descriptor.
Added the readiness-writing scene: the paragraph and two-sides prerequisites are diagnosed by production, with fallback routes in definitions pl-d0 and pl-d2.
write-conclusion stays practice. Conclusion evidence is counted only in definition pl-dr2, where the learner writes the argument the conclusion closes.
